program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: residual calibration attribution after failed hard instability gate
question: Within historically sign-unstable candidate allocations, does training-only majority-positive sign polarity identify a productive subgroup that the R30 hard gate incorrectly excluded, relative to the remaining unstable candidates, before any held-out outcome is opened?
hypothesis: R30 failed because binary sign stability is too coarse: some unstable candidates are still systematically productive. For each outer holdout, use only the other three manifests to count each non-equal candidate's positive, negative, and zero actual-advantage signs and freeze a majority-positive-unstable flag before held-out outcomes open. After the flag set is frozen, evaluate held-out actual advantage. A supported result requires majority-positive unstable candidates to cover at least 20% of unstable cases, exceed the remaining unstable candidates' held-out positive rate by at least 0.15, and have higher mean held-out actual advantage. This is attribution only; no selection policy changes.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: historical sign instability should be treated as a universal hard exclusion criterion
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: historical sign instability is heterogeneous; training-only sign polarity inside the unstable class may distinguish productive from harmful instability

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: The R30 hard instability gate reduced total actual advantage from +31 to +5. It avoided one harmful fifth-manifest reallocation but forfeited larger positive opportunities on transfer, third, and fourth.
cause_effect_trace.internal_diagnostic: R30 collapsed 33 unstable candidate cases into one forbidden class and only 3 non-equal cases were stable across outer holdouts.
cause_effect_trace.attributed_residual_candidate: coarse instability grouping hides asymmetric sign structure
cause_effect_trace.diagnostic_mechanism: for every unstable non-equal candidate, count positive/negative/zero training-manifest actual-advantage signs and freeze majority_positive_unstable = positive_count >= 2 before held-out outcome construction
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: diagnostic grouping and accounting only; no selection, model, feature, budget, capacity, candidate, manifest, or tie-break changes
cause_effect_trace.qualification: same four sealed manifests, exact 1744 budget, deterministic double replay, full Go regression, READY_RESEARCH, all diagnostic flags frozen before held-out outcomes open
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R31 cannot change allocator behavior. A supported attribution may justify a separately preregistered bounded asymmetric-instability correction; mixed/negative does not.
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: supported -> test a bounded asymmetric-instability correction; mixed/negative -> continue residual magnitude/calibration attribution

frozen_reuse.model: unchanged R27 ridge fit and features

diagnostic_rule.unstable: training actual-advantage signs across the three non-held-out manifests contain more than one distinct sign
diagnostic_rule.majority_positive_unstable: unstable AND positive training sign count >= 2
diagnostic_rule.other_unstable: unstable AND positive training sign count < 2
diagnostic_rule.heldout_ordering: all sign counts and subgroup flags freeze before held-out outcomes are constructed

classification_rules.supported: valid AND majority_positive_unstable_coverage >= 0.20 AND majority_positive_positive_rate_delta >= 0.15 AND majority_positive_mean_advantage_delta > 0
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND majority_positive_positive_rate_delta > 0 AND majority_positive_mean_advantage_delta > 0 but supported criterion is not met
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, candidate set, training-only sign-count calculation, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

rsi_success_note: R31 is attribution on already studied manifests and cannot establish allocator success.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, candidates, subgroup definition, thresholds, budgets/capacity, model/features, held-out ordering, classification, or authority after primary output.
